query: I was walking my golden retriever puppy this morning and he chased a squirrel right into a flower bed, getting his paws all muddy. I had to stop by the pet store on the way home to pick up a new bottle of paw cleaner and a bag of his favorite sweet potato treats, since we ran out last week. The cashier even gave me a free sample of a new dental chew that he seemed really interested in while I was checking out. Anyway, my mobile data isn’t working at all right now. I checked and airplane mode is turned on, I think my network preference is set wrong, data saver mode is enabled, I already used up all my monthly data allowance, and I’m traveling abroad right now with roaming turned off, can you help me fix this?
